Additional live checks: PUT /api/members/me with chapter_id as a member returns 403 with the correct 'Request chapter change' message; POST /me/chapter-change-request 200/409/404 flows work; admin-only endpoints (/admin/chapter-change-requests, /admin/checkins/import-csv) return 403 for members. context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 150 fully validated. The only code change made by testing agent was removing a dead duplicate JSX block in Awards.jsx (lines ~869-876) that prevented the frontend from compiling. All 10 backend regression tests pass. To visually verify governor-bio-{id} on Regions, seed a region with an assigned governor+bio via /admin/members/{id}/region + user bio.
rca of the issue: Awards.jsx contained a leftover duplicate `{isAdmin && }` fragment plus extra closing `);}` that sat OUTSIDE the enclosing function body (after the function had already returned and been closed on line 868). Babel could not parse the file → the entire React app failed to render → login page never loaded assets → every UI test would time out. Repro: `curl /awards` prior to fix returned the 'Compiled with problems' overlay HTML. Mitigation: removed the dangling block; frontend hot-reloads and compiles cleanly. Long-term: enable a pre-commit `yarn build` or `eslint --max-warnings=0` check to prevent shipping non-compiling JSX.
